# linux_command (Action)

Runs a shell script with `/bin/sh`, for instance after a resource changes. Requires Terraform 1.14 or later.

## Example Usage

```terraform
action "linux_command" "migrate" {
  config {
    command           = "./bin/migrate up"
    working_directory = "/opt/app"
  }
}

resource "linux_file" "release" {
  path    = "/opt/app/RELEASE"
  content = var.release

  lifecycle {
    action_trigger {
      events  = [after_create, after_update]
      actions = [action.linux_command.migrate]
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `command` (String) Script to run.

### Optional

- `environment` (Map of String) Environment variables exported to the script.
- `working_directory` (String) Directory the script runs in.
